ui.include.title: Eingebundene Konfigurationsdateien
ui.include.desc: Organisieren Sie Ihre modulare Klipper-Konfiguration durch externe.cfg-Dateien.
ui.macro.title: Benutzerdefinierte G-Code-Makros
ui.macro.desc: Verwalten, erstellen und bearbeiten Sie Makros für Druckabläufe in Mainsail.
ui.modal.ip_helper: Wenn Klipper Configurator auf demselben Host wie Mainsail läuft, automatischen Ursprung beibehalten.
ui.modal.auto_lang_helper: When set to Automatic, Klipper Configurator adopts the language configured in Mainsail.
ui.helper.kinematics: Specifies the kinematic motion model of the toolhead and axes.
ui.helper.enable_idex: Enables the secondary independent [dual_carriage] on X axis and secondary [extruder1].
ui.helper.z_motor_count: Automatically updates available motors in the Stepper tab and leveling options in the Calibration tab.
ui.helper.mcu_serial: Unique Linux USB serial port path.
ui.helper.mcu_canbus: 12-digit CAN bus UUID identifier of the board.
ui.helper.host_temp: Displays Raspberry Pi / Host CPU temperature in Mainsail.
ui.helper.mcu_temp: Displays mainboard microcontroller STM32/RP2040 chip temperature.
ui.helper.stepper_rot_dist: 40 for GT2 20-tooth belts, 8.0 for T8x8 leadscrews, 4.0 for T8x4.
ui.helper.stepper_endstop: Use '^' for internal pull-up. For sensorless: tmc2209_stepper_x:virtual_endstop
ui.helper.stepper_z_notice: Travel limits and endstop for auxiliary Z axes are handled by the main [stepper_z].
ui.helper.driver_uart: UART serial communication pin for this axis.
ui.helper.driver_tx: Optional. Specify only if the board uses separate RX and TX pins.
ui.helper.driver_address: Optional. Used when multiple drivers share the same physical UART pin.
ui.helper.driver_cs: Dedicated Chip Select pin for this driver.
ui.helper.driver_spi_bus: SPI bus configured on the MCU.
ui.helper.driver_hold_current: Reduced current at standstill. Prevents overheating. If disabled, Klipper maintains run_current constant.
ui.helper.driver_sense_resistor: Klipper default: 0.110 Ω for TMC2209/2208/2226, 0.075 Ω for TMC5160. Enable only if board uses non-standard resistor.
ui.helper.pressure_advance: Typically 0.02 - 0.06 for Direct Drive, 0.3 - 0.8 for Bowden.
ui.helper.extruder_rtd_nominal: 100 Ω for standard PT100, 1000 Ω for PT1000.
ui.helper.extruder_rtd_reference: 430 Ω for PT100 boards, 4300 Ω for PT1000 boards.
ui.helper.extruder_rtd_wires: Number of physical conductors connected to the RTD probe.
ui.helper.extruder_rtd_filter: Filters electrical mains line noise oscillations.
ui.helper.extruder_control: Select PID to maintain precise, steady hotend temperature.
ui.helper.extruder_max_delta: Klipper default: 2.0°C. Heater turns off when exceeding target temperature + max_delta.
ui.helper.extruder_current: Typically 0.500A - 0.700A for pancake / compact extruder motors.
ui.helper.extruder_hold_current_warn: Standstill current. NOTE: On extruders, setting this too low is discouraged to prevent skipped steps upon resuming extrusion.
ui.helper.bed_max_delta: Klipper default: 2.0°C. Shuts off bed when exceeding target temperature + max_delta.
ui.helper.bed_pid_tip: Tip: To calibrate bed PID from Mainsail console send: PID_CALIBRATE HEATER=heater_bed TARGET=60
ui.helper.fan_part: Wird vom Slicer über M106 / M107 gesteuert.
ui.helper.adxl_cs: Z.B.: rpi:None am Raspberry Pi oder SPI-CS-Pin der MCU.
ui.helper.adxl_axes_map: Z.B.: x, y, z oder x, -z, y entsprechend der Einbaulage.
ui.helper.z_tilt_points: Bett-Koordinaten, an denen die Neigung gemessen wird.
ui.helper.res_accel_chip: Name des in der Konfiguration definierten Beschleunigungssensors.
ui.helper.res_max_smoothing: Leer lassen für automatische Berechnung durch Klipper.
ui.helper.calib_z_offset: Vertikaler Auslöseabstand zwischen Sonde und Düsenspitze.
ui.helper.extruder_driver_uart: UART serial communication pin for the extruder.
ui.helper.extruder_driver_cs: Dedicated CS pin for the extruder driver.
ui.notice.homing_zero: ℹ️ Note: Homing parameters set to 0 are omitted from the configuration file to keep Klipper's internal defaults active.
ui.chk.host_temp: Enable Raspberry Pi / Host CPU Temperature Sensor
ui.placeholder.moonraker_url: http://192.168.1.50:7125 or leave empty for auto-detection
ui.mcu.helper_name: Dieser Name identifiziert den Mikrocontroller und seine Pins.
ui.helper.fan_stepper: Leer lassen, um alle Motoren zu überwachen.
ui.include.empty_hint: Nutzen Sie die Schnellwahl-Buttons oben oder 'Neue Include-Datei'.

labels.check-enable-host-temp: Enable Raspberry Pi / Host Temperature Sensor

select-config-file.title: File di Configurazione Attivo
select-config-file.desc: Seleziona quale file di configurazione Klipper caricare, visualizzare o modificare da Moonraker.

printer-kinematics.title: Main Kinematics Type
printer-kinematics.desc: Defines the mechanical kinematic structure of the printer (Cartesian, CoreXY, CoreXZ, Delta, Hybrid CoreXY, etc.).
printer-kinematics.tip: Ender 3: cartesian | Voron: corexy | Delta: delta

printer-max-velocity.title: Maximum Velocity
printer-max-velocity.desc: Maximum toolhead travel speed allowed on the horizontal XY plane.

printer-max-accel.title: Maximum Acceleration
printer-max-accel.desc: Maximum acceleration permitted for the toolhead.
printer-max-accel.tip: Typical: 3000 - 5000 mm/s² (Cartesian), 5000 - 20000+ mm/s² (CoreXY with input shaper)

printer-cruise-ratio.title: Minimum Cruise Ratio
printer-cruise-ratio.desc: Minimum fraction of travel distance spent at constant cruise velocity before decelerating. Replaces max_accel_to_decel.

printer-square-corner.title: Square Corner Velocity
printer-square-corner.desc: Maximum velocity at which the toolhead may negotiate a 90° turn without decelerating to zero.

printer-max-z-velocity.title: Maximum Z Velocity
printer-max-z-velocity.desc: Maximum vertical travel speed allowed for the Z axis.

printer-max-z-accel.title: Maximum Z Acceleration
printer-max-z-accel.desc: Maximum acceleration applied during Z axis vertical motions and hops.

printer-max-accel-to-decel.title: Max Accel to Decel (Legacy)
printer-max-accel-to-decel.desc: Parametro deprecato di Klipper per limitare l'accelerazione di transizione. Nei sistemi moderni è consigliato lasciare vuoto e utilizzare minimum_cruise_ratio.

check-enable-idex.title: Abilitazione Cinematica IDEX
check-enable-idex.desc: Attiva il supporto per stampanti a doppio carrello indipendente (IDEX), consentendo la gestione separata di due estrusori autonomi che condividono la stessa barra X.
check-enable-idex.tip: Genera automaticamente la sezione [dual_carriage] nel config

select-z-motor-count.title: Numero di Motori Asse Z
select-z-motor-count.desc: Specifica quanti motori indipendenti comandano l'asse Z (1, 2, 3 o 4). Permette il livellamento automatico del piatto o gantry tramite Z_TILT_ADJUST (2-3 motori) o QUAD_GANTRY_LEVEL (4 motori).
select-z-motor-count.tip: Configura schede stepper_z, stepper_z1, stepper_z2, stepper_z3

delta-arm-length.title: Lunghezza Bracci Delta
delta-arm-length.desc: Lunghezza da snodo a snodo dei bracci diagonali su stampanti cinematiche Delta.

delta-radius.title: Raggio Orizzontale Delta
delta-radius.desc: Raggio del cerchio orizzontale formato dalle torri delta rispetto al centro dell'effettore.

delta-print-radius.title: Raggio di Stampa Delta
delta-print-radius.desc: Raggio dell'area circolare massima stampabile sul piano di lavoro di una cinematica Delta.

x-pos-min.title: Minimum Travel Position
x-pos-min.desc: Minimum coordinate reachable on this axis.

x-pos-max.title: Maximum Travel Position
x-pos-max.desc: Maximum coordinate reachable on this axis (print volume limit).

x-pos-endstop.title: Endstop Trigger Position
x-pos-endstop.desc: Exact coordinate assigned when endstop is triggered.

x-homing-speed.title: Homing Travel Speed
x-homing-speed.desc: Speed at which the axis moves towards endstop during homing.

x-homing-retract-dist.title: Distanza di Arretramento Homing
x-homing-retract-dist.desc: Distanza di cui l'asse indietreggia dopo il primo contatto col finecorsa, prima di eseguire il secondo tocco di precisione.
x-homing-retract-dist.tip: Tipicamente 3 - 5 mm. Imposta 0 per sensorless homing

x-homing-retract-speed.title: Velocità di Arretramento Homing
x-homing-retract-speed.desc: Velocità con cui l'asse si allontana dal finecorsa prima del secondo tocco.

dc-pos-min.title: Minimum Travel Position
dc-pos-min.desc: Minimum coordinate reachable on this axis.

dc-pos-max.title: Maximum Travel Position
dc-pos-max.desc: Maximum coordinate reachable on this axis (print volume limit).

dc-pos-endstop.title: Endstop Trigger Position
dc-pos-endstop.desc: Exact coordinate assigned when endstop is triggered.

dc-homing-speed.title: Homing Travel Speed
dc-homing-speed.desc: Speed at which the axis moves towards endstop during homing.

dc-homing-retract-dist.title: Arretramento Homing Carrello X2
dc-homing-retract-dist.desc: Distanza di arretramento dopo il tocco dell'endstop per il carrello X2.

dc-homing-retract-speed.title: Velocità Arretramento X2
dc-homing-retract-speed.desc: Velocità di disimpegno dal finecorsa del carrello secondario X2.

y-pos-min.title: Minimum Travel Position
y-pos-min.desc: Minimum coordinate reachable on this axis.

y-pos-max.title: Maximum Travel Position
y-pos-max.desc: Maximum coordinate reachable on this axis (print volume limit).

y-pos-endstop.title: Endstop Trigger Position
y-pos-endstop.desc: Exact coordinate assigned when endstop is triggered.

y-homing-speed.title: Homing Travel Speed
y-homing-speed.desc: Speed at which the axis moves towards endstop during homing.

y-homing-retract-dist.title: Arretramento Homing Asse Y
y-homing-retract-dist.desc: Distanza di arretramento dopo il primo tocco del finecorsa su Y.

y-homing-retract-speed.title: Velocità Arretramento Asse Y
y-homing-retract-speed.desc: Velocità di arretramento per l'asse Y.

z-pos-min.title: Minimum Travel Position
z-pos-min.desc: Minimum coordinate reachable on this axis.
z-pos-min.tip: Consigliato: -2.0 o -5.0 mm per calibrare Z-Offset

z-pos-max.title: Maximum Travel Position
z-pos-max.desc: Maximum coordinate reachable on this axis (print volume limit).

z-pos-endstop.title: Endstop Trigger Position
z-pos-endstop.desc: Exact coordinate assigned when endstop is triggered.

z-homing-speed.title: Homing Travel Speed
z-homing-speed.desc: Speed at which the axis moves towards endstop during homing.
z-homing-speed.tip: Tipicamente 5 - 15 mm/s per evitare impatti violenti

z-homing-retract-dist.title: Arretramento Homing Asse Z
z-homing-retract-dist.desc: Distanza di risalita della testina dopo il primo tocco prima del secondo tocco di homing.

z-homing-retract-speed.title: Velocità Arretramento Asse Z
z-homing-retract-speed.desc: Velocità di risalita tra il primo e il secondo tocco di homing.

mcu-conn-type.title: Metodo di Collegamento Scheda MCU
mcu-conn-type.desc: Indica se la scheda principale comunica con l'host tramite porta seriale USB (/dev/serial/by-id/...) o tramite bus di rete CAN Bus a 2 fili.
mcu-conn-type.tip: USB Seriale per schede madri convenzionali, CAN Bus per toolhead/EBB

mcu-canbus-uuid.title: CAN Bus UUID
mcu-canbus-uuid.desc: 12-digit hexadecimal unique identifier for CAN board.
mcu-canbus-uuid.tip: Rilevabile con il comando: python3 ~/klipper/scripts/canbus_query.py can0

mcu-restart-method.title: Metodo di Reset Hardware MCU
mcu-restart-method.desc: Algoritmo usato da Klipper per riavviare la scheda microcontrollore quando si invia il comando FIRMWARE_RESTART.

check-enable-host-temp.title: Sensore Temperatura Host / Raspberry Pi
check-enable-host-temp.desc: Abilita il monitoraggio continuo della temperatura della CPU del Raspberry Pi o computer host nella dashboard Mainsail.

check-enable-mcu-temp.title: Sensore Temperatura Chip MCU
check-enable-mcu-temp.desc: Abilita la lettura del sensore di temperatura interno integrato nel microcontrollore della scheda madre.

stepper-step-pin.title: Step Signal Pin
stepper-step-pin.desc: Microcontroller pin that pulses step clock cycles to the stepper driver.

stepper-dir-pin.title: Direction Pin
stepper-dir-pin.desc: Pin setting the motor rotation direction. Prepend ! to invert direction.

check-invert-dir.title: Inverti Direzione Motore
check-invert-dir.desc: Aggiunge il prefisso punto esclamativo ! al dir_pin per invertire istantaneamente il verso di marcia dell'asse.
check-invert-dir.tip: Seleziona se l'asse si allontana dal finecorsa invece di avvicinarsi

stepper-enable-pin.title: Enable Pin
stepper-enable-pin.desc: Pin enabling driver power (usually active-low, requiring !).

check-invert-enable.title: Inverti Logica Enable
check-invert-enable.desc: Abilita o disabilita il prefisso ! sul pin di abilitazione (logica invertita).
check-invert-enable.tip: Generalmente attivo (!) per quasi tutti i driver moderni

stepper-microsteps.title: Microstep Resolution
stepper-microsteps.desc: Microstepping multiplier set inside the driver for smooth motion.

stepper-steps-rotation.title: Passi Nativi del Motore per Giro Completo
stepper-steps-rotation.desc: Numero di passi fisici completi per una rotazione di 360° dell'albero motore: 200 per motori convenzionali con angolo di 1.8°, 400 per motori ad alta precisione con angolo di 0.9°.

stepper-rotation-distance.title: Rotation Distance
stepper-rotation-distance.desc: Linear distance (in mm) traveled by the axis for one full 360° turn of the stepper motor.

stepper-endstop-pin.title: Pin del Finecorsa (Endstop Pin)
stepper-endstop-pin.desc: Pin digitale a cui è collegato lo switch di finecorsa per questo asse. Anteporre ^ se lo switch richiede pull-up interno, oppure tmc2209_stepper_x:virtual_endstop per sensorless.

driver-model-select.title: Modello Chip Driver
driver-model-select.desc: Seleziona il circuito integrato del driver installato: TMC2209, TMC2208, TMC2240, TMC5160, TMC2130 o Standalone (A4988, DRV8825). Definisce la sezione nel config.
driver-model-select.tip: TMC2209 è il più comune per rapporto silenziosità/affidabilità

driver-conn-type-select.title: Tipo di Connessione Driver
driver-conn-type-select.desc: Metodo con cui il microcontrollore comunica con il chip TMC: UART (filo singolo bidirezionale), SPI (bus seriale ad alta velocità a 4 fili) o Standalone (nessuna configurazione digitale).
driver-conn-type-select.tip: UART per TMC2209/TMC2208 | SPI per TMC5160/TMC2130

driver-uart-pin.title: UART Pin
driver-uart-pin.desc: MCU digital serial pin configuring TMC driver registers.

driver-tx-pin.title: Pin TX UART (Opzionale)
driver-tx-pin.desc: Pin di trasmissione dedicato se la scheda madre usa linee separate per invio e ricezione UART verso i driver.
driver-tx-pin.tip: Lasciare vuoto se la scheda usa filo singolo UART con resistenza

driver-uart-address.title: Indirizzo Hardware UART
driver-uart-address.desc: Indirizzo univoco (da 0 a 3) assegnato al driver TMC quando più driver condividono lo stesso identico pin UART (es. schede MKS Robin o BTT E3).
driver-uart-address.tip: Tipicamente 0 per X, 1 per Y, 2 per Z, 3 per E0 su schede a bus condiviso

driver-cs-pin.title: Pin Chip Select (CS) SPI
driver-cs-pin.desc: Pin digitale che attiva la comunicazione con questo specifico driver durante le transazioni sul bus dati SPI.

driver-spi-mode.title: Modalità Bus SPI
driver-spi-mode.desc: Sceglie se appoggiarsi a un controller SPI hardware integrato nel chip MCU oppure emulare il bus SPI via bit-banging software su pin generici.
driver-spi-mode.tip: Hardware SPI per massima velocità e minor carico CPU

driver-spi-bus.title: Nome Bus SPI Hardware
driver-spi-bus.desc: Identificativo del controller SPI hardware della scheda madre (es. spi1, spi2, spi3a, spi4).
driver-spi-bus.tip: Consultare il pinout ufficiale della propria scheda madre

driver-spi-sclk.title: Pin Clock SPI Software
driver-spi-sclk.desc: Pin digitale adibito al segnale di sincronizzazione di clock (SCK/SCLK) per SPI software.

driver-spi-mosi.title: Pin MOSI SPI Software
driver-spi-mosi.desc: Pin Master Out Slave In per l'invio dei comandi di configurazione al driver.

driver-spi-miso.title: Pin MISO SPI Software
driver-spi-miso.desc: Pin Master In Slave Out per la lettura dei registri di stato e diagnostica dal driver.

driver-run-current.title: Operating Run Current
driver-run-current.desc: RMS current supplied to the stepper motor windings during movement.

driver-stealthchop.title: StealthChop Mode
driver-stealthchop.desc: Enables ultra-quiet StealthChop mode. Disable (0) for high-speed SpreadCycle power.
driver-stealthchop.tip: Abilitato (999999) per silenzio | Disabilitato (0) per massima coppia e velocità

check-enable-hold-current.title: Abilita Corrente di Mantenimento
check-enable-hold-current.desc: Permette di ridurre la corrente quando il motore è fermo. Sconsigliato con TMC2209 e sensorless homing poiché la commutazione improvvisa può causare salti di microstep.
check-enable-hold-current.tip: Spesso lasciata disabilitata per massima stabilità

driver-hold-current.title: Hold Current
driver-hold-current.desc: Current supplied when motor is standing still in stationary position.

check-enable-sense-resistor.title: Specifica Resistenza di Sense
check-enable-sense-resistor.desc: Permette di impostare manualmente il valore esatto della resistenza shunt di campionamento corrente saldata sul modulo driver.
check-enable-sense-resistor.tip: Necessario se diverso dal valore di fabbrica (0.110 ohm)

driver-sense-resistor.title: Current Sense Resistor
driver-sense-resistor.desc: Value of the shunt resistor on the driver module to measure current.

driver-interpolate.title: 256 Microstep Interpolation
driver-interpolate.desc: Driver automatically interpolates microsteps to 256 internal microsteps.

driver-sensorless-enable.title: Homing Senza Finecorsa Fisico (Sensorless)
driver-sensorless-enable.desc: Utilizza la tecnologia StallGuard del chip TMC per rilevare l'impatto meccanico a fine corsa attraverso il monitoraggio della contro-forza elettromotrice (back-EMF).
driver-sensorless-enable.tip: Elimina i cavi e gli interruttori fisici di finecorsa su X e Y

driver-diag-pin.title: StallGuard Diag Pin
driver-diag-pin.desc: Pin signaling mechanical stall for sensorless homing.

driver-sgthrs.title: StallGuard Sensitivity
driver-sgthrs.desc: Collision sensitivity for sensorless homing. TMC2209: 0 to 255 (typical 60 - 120).
driver-sgthrs.tip: TMC2209: iniziare da 100 e regolare a passi di 5 (tipico: 60 - 120)

extruder-step-pin.title: Step Signal Pin
extruder-step-pin.desc: Microcontroller pin that pulses step clock cycles to the stepper driver.

extruder-dir-pin.title: Direction Pin
extruder-dir-pin.desc: Pin setting the motor rotation direction. Prepend ! to invert direction.

extruder-enable-pin.title: Enable Pin
extruder-enable-pin.desc: Pin enabling driver power (usually active-low, requiring !).

extruder-rot-dist.title: Rotation Distance
extruder-rot-dist.desc: Linear distance (in mm) traveled by the axis for one full 360° turn of the stepper motor.

extruder-gear-ratio.title: Rapporto di Riduzione Ingranaggi
extruder-gear-ratio.desc: Rapporto di trasmissione meccanico tra pignone motore e ingranaggi di trascinamento dell'estrusore.
extruder-gear-ratio.tip: BMG: 50:17 | Clockwork 1/2: 50:10 | Orbiter 2.0: 7.5:1 | Azionamento diretto: lascia vuoto

extruder-nozzle-dia.title: Nozzle Orifice Diameter
extruder-nozzle-dia.desc: Hole diameter of the installed nozzle on the hotend.

extruder-filament-dia.title: Filament Diameter
extruder-filament-dia.desc: Nominal diameter of the thermoplastic filament (1.75 mm or 2.85 mm).
extruder-filament-dia.tip: Standard: 1.75 mm (o 2.85 mm per sistemi speciali)

extruder-pressure-advance.title: Pressure Advance
extruder-pressure-advance.desc: Active compensation for filament elasticity and nozzle chamber pressure during acceleration.

extruder-sensor-type.title: Temperature Sensor Model
extruder-sensor-type.desc: Exact model of thermistor, thermocouple or RTD probe.
extruder-sensor-type.tip: Impostare il modello corretto per evitare scarti di temperatura pericolosi

extruder-heater-pin.title: Heater Cartridge Pin
extruder-heater-pin.desc: MCU MOSFET pin driving heater PWM power.

extruder-sensor-pin.title: Sensor ADC Pin
extruder-sensor-pin.desc: Microcontroller analog ADC pin reading temperature.

extruder-min-temp.title: Thermal Safety Minimum
extruder-min-temp.desc: Minimum allowed temperature (°C). Triggers shutdown if disconnected.

extruder-max-temp.title: Thermal Safety Maximum
extruder-max-temp.desc: Maximum allowed temperature before emergency thermal shutdown.
extruder-max-temp.tip: Gola in PTFE: max 250°C | All-Metal: 280 - 300°C | Hotend per tecnopolimeri: 350 - 500°C

extruder-min-extrude.title: Minimum Extrude Temperature
extruder-min-extrude.desc: Safety threshold preventing cold extrusion commands.

extruder-control-type.title: Thermal Control Algorithm
extruder-control-type.desc: PID (Proportional Integral Derivative) or Watermark hysteresis.
extruder-control-type.tip: Usa sempre PID per l'hotend per stabilità termica millimetrica

extruder-max-delta.title: Tolleranza Isteresi Watermark
extruder-max-delta.desc: Finestra di isteresi termica ammessa attorno al target quando si impiega l'algoritmo watermark.

extruder-rtd-nominal-r.title: Resistenza Nominale Sonda RTD a 0°C
extruder-rtd-nominal-r.desc: Resistenza elettrica della sonda termoresistiva al platino a zero gradi Celsius: 100 per sonde PT100, 1000 per sonde PT1000.

extruder-rtd-reference-r.title: Resistenza di Riferimento Modulo RTD
extruder-rtd-reference-r.desc: Valore della resistenza campione saldata sul circuito integrato MAX31865 (solitamente 430 ohm per PT100, 4300 ohm per PT1000).
extruder-rtd-reference-r.tip: Modulo per PT100: 430 | Modulo per PT1000: 4300

extruder-rtd-num-wires.title: Numero di Conduttori Sonda RTD
extruder-rtd-num-wires.desc: Configurazione fisica del cablaggio della termoresistenza (2, 3 o 4 fili). Le configurazioni a 3 o 4 fili compensano la resistenza interna dei cavi per massima accuratezza.

extruder-rtd-filter.title: Filtro Antidisturbo Rete Elettrica
extruder-rtd-filter.desc: Seleziona il filtro notch a 50Hz (standard europeo/italiano a 230V) o 60Hz per abbattere i disturbi indotti dalla rete elettrica sulle letture della sonda.

bed-sensor-type.title: Temperature Sensor Model
bed-sensor-type.desc: Exact model of thermistor, thermocouple or RTD probe.

bed-heater-pin.title: Heater Cartridge Pin
bed-heater-pin.desc: MCU MOSFET pin driving heater PWM power.

bed-sensor-pin.title: Sensor ADC Pin
bed-sensor-pin.desc: Microcontroller analog ADC pin reading temperature.

bed-min-temp.title: Thermal Safety Minimum
bed-min-temp.desc: Minimum allowed temperature (°C). Triggers shutdown if disconnected.

bed-max-temp.title: Thermal Safety Maximum
bed-max-temp.desc: Maximum allowed temperature before emergency thermal shutdown.

bed-control-type.title: Thermal Control Algorithm
bed-control-type.desc: PID (Proportional Integral Derivative) or Watermark hysteresis.
bed-control-type.tip: Piatto 24V DC: pid | Piatto 230V AC con SSR: watermark o pid

bed-max-delta.title: Tolleranza Isteresi Watermark Piatto
bed-max-delta.desc: Scarto ammesso attorno alla temperatura impostata con algoritmo watermark (es. 1.0 - 2.0°C).

probe-type-select.title: Tipologia Sonda di Livellamento
probe-type-select.desc: Tipo di sensore impiegato per mappare la planarità del piatto: BLTouch / 3DTouch, microswitch meccanico (Klicky/Voron Tap), sensore induttivo (Omron/SuperPinda), Beacon o sonda a correnti parassite BTT Eddy.

probe-sensor-pin.title: Sensor ADC Pin
probe-sensor-pin.desc: Microcontroller analog ADC pin reading temperature.

probe-control-pin.title: Pin di Controllo Servocomando (BLTouch)
probe-control-pin.desc: Pin PWM che comanda l'estrazione e la ritrazione dello spillo per sensori BLTouch e cloni.

probe-x-offset.title: Distanza X Sonda-Ugello
probe-x-offset.desc: Distanza orizzontale in millimetri tra l'ugello e il punto di contatto della sonda lungo l'asse X. Positiva se la sonda è a destra dell'ugello, negativa se è a sinistra.
probe-x-offset.tip: 0.0 se la sonda è coassiale all'ugello (es. Voron Tap o Eddy su ugello)

probe-y-offset.title: Distanza Y Sonda-Ugello
probe-y-offset.desc: Distanza orizzontale in millimetri tra l'ugello e la sonda lungo l'asse Y. Positiva se la sonda è dietro l'ugello, negativa se è davanti.

probe-z-offset.title: Probe Z-Offset
probe-z-offset.desc: Vertical distance between nozzle tip and probe trigger point.
probe-z-offset.tip: Maggiore è il valore, più l'ugello scende vicino al piatto

probe-samples.title: Campionamenti per Singolo Punto
probe-samples.desc: Numero di letture consecutive effettuate per ogni punto della griglia per eliminare rumore e letture anomale.

probe-samples-result.title: Metodo di Aggregazione Campioni
probe-samples-result.desc: Come combinare i campioni rilevati sullo stesso punto: median (valore mediano, più robusto contro anomalie) o average (media aritmetica).

check-enable-safe-z.title: Abilita Safe Z Home
check-enable-safe-z.desc: Esegue l'azzeramento dell'asse Z al centro del piatto anziché agli angoli, prevenendo impatti se si usa una sonda montata sulla testina.
check-enable-safe-z.tip: Obbligatorio quando si usa una sonda (BLTouch/Tap) come endstop Z

safe-z-pos.title: Coordinate Centro Homing Z
safe-z-pos.desc: Coordinate X, Y a cui spostare la testina prima di far scendere la sonda per l'homing Z (tipicamente il centro del piatto).

safe-z-hop.title: Altezza di Sicurezza Z-Hop
safe-z-hop.desc: Distanza di sollevamento preventivo dell'asse Z prima e dopo l'homing per evitare di strisciare l'ugello o la sonda sul piatto.

safe-z-speed.title: Velocità di Spostamento Safe Z
safe-z-speed.desc: Velocità di traslazione della testina verso le coordinate di homing Z sicuro.

mesh-min.title: Bed Mesh Minimum
mesh-min.desc: Minimum X,Y probe coordinates for heightmap leveling.

mesh-max.title: Bed Mesh Maximum
mesh-max.desc: Maximum X,Y probe coordinates for heightmap leveling.

mesh-probe-count.title: Mesh Grid Resolution
mesh-probe-count.desc: Number of sample points along X and Y (e.g. 5,5 or 7,7).
mesh-probe-count.tip: Es. 5,5 (25 punti) o 7,7 (49 punti per piatti ampi)

mesh-algorithm.title: Algoritmo di Interpolazione Mesh
mesh-algorithm.desc: Algoritmo matematico per calcolare le quote tra i punti tastati: bicubic (consigliato per griglie dense 5x5 o superiori) o lagrange (solo per griglie piccole 3x3).

z-tilt-positions.title: Punti Pivot Motori Z (z_positions)
z-tilt-positions.desc: Coordinate fisiche (X, Y) dei fulcri o viti dei motori Z indipendenti per allineare il piatto con Z_TILT_ADJUST.
z-tilt-positions.tip: Una coppia X, Y per ogni motore Z

z-tilt-points.title: Punti di Tastatura Z-Tilt
z-tilt-points.desc: Coordinate sul piatto dove la sonda misurerà l'inclinazione per calcolare i passi correttivi di ciascun motore Z.

z-tilt-retries.title: Tentativi Massimi Z-Tilt
z-tilt-retries.desc: Numero massimo di cicli di misurazione consentiti per raggiungere la planarità desiderata.

z-tilt-tolerance.title: Tolleranza Livellamento Z-Tilt
z-tilt-tolerance.desc: Scarto massimo tollerato tra i punti Z (in mm) per considerare il piatto perfettamente livellato.

qgl-corners.title: Coordinate Angoli Gantry (Voron QGL)
qgl-corners.desc: Coordinate fisiche dei 4 angoli del carrello sospeso su stampanti tipo Voron 2.4 con Quad Gantry Level.

qgl-points.title: 4 Punti di Tastatura QGL
qgl-points.desc: Coordinate dei 4 punti da sondare sul piatto per calcolare la correzione indipendente dei 4 motori Z.

qgl-retries.title: Tentativi Massimi QGL
qgl-retries.desc: Numero massimo di cicli prima di considerare fallito il livellamento a 4 motori.

qgl-tolerance.title: Tolleranza Quad Gantry Level
qgl-tolerance.desc: Differenza massima accettabile tra i 4 angoli per completare la procedura.

fan-part-pin.title: Pin Ventola Raffreddamento Pezzo
fan-part-pin.desc: Pin PWM collegato alla ventola del layer che raffredda il filamento estruso sul pezzo, comandabile via G-Code M106.

fan-part-kick.title: Tempo Spunto Iniziale Ventola
fan-part-kick.desc: Durata dell'impulso al 100% di potenza (in secondi) erogato all'avvio per vincere l'inerzia iniziale delle ventole.

fan-part-off-below.title: Soglia Minima Spegnimento Ventola
fan-part-off-below.desc: Velocità minima al di sotto della quale la ventola non riceve alimentazione per evitare ronzii senza rotazione.

check-enable-shaper.title: Abilitazione Filtro Input Shaper
check-enable-shaper.desc: Attiva la compensazione attiva delle vibrazioni e risonanze meccaniche, eliminando l'effetto eco (ghosting/ringing) sulle superfici verticali ad alte velocità.

shaper-freq-x.title: X Resonance Frequency
shaper-freq-x.desc: Natural vibration resonance frequency of X axis in Hz.

shaper-type-x.title: X Shaper Filter Type
shaper-type-x.desc: Vibration damping algorithm (e.g. MZV, EI, ZV).
shaper-type-x.tip: MZV ed EI sono tra i più diffusi ed equilibrati

shaper-freq-y.title: Y Resonance Frequency
shaper-freq-y.desc: Natural vibration resonance frequency of Y axis in Hz.

shaper-type-y.title: Y Shaper Filter Type
shaper-type-y.desc: Vibration damping algorithm for Y axis.

check-enable-adxl.title: Abilitazione Accelerometro ADXL345
check-enable-adxl.desc: Configura il chip accelerometro digitale SPI per la misurazione automatica in tempo reale delle risonanze meccaniche con il comando TEST_RESONANCES.
check-enable-adxl.tip: Collegabile a scheda host, toolhead board o Raspberry Pi

adxl-cs-pin.title: Pin Chip Select ADXL345
adxl-cs-pin.desc: Pin digitale per selezionare l'accelerometro sul bus SPI.
adxl-cs-pin.tip: Es. rpi:None o gpio pin su toolhead

adxl-spi-bus.title: Bus SPI Accelerometro
adxl-spi-bus.desc: Nome del bus SPI hardware utilizzato per leggere i dati dall'accelerometro (es. spidev0.0, spi1).

adxl-axes-map.title: Orientamento Assi Accelerometro
adxl-axes-map.desc: Mappatura degli assi fisici del chip rispetto agli assi di movimento della stampante.
adxl-axes-map.tip: Default: x,y,z (invertibile es. -x,z,y se montato verticalmente)

adxl-rate.title: Campionamento ADXL345
adxl-rate.desc: Frequenza di acquisizione dati dell'accelerometro (da 1600 Hz a 3200 Hz).

res-accel-chip.title: Chip Accelerometro di Riferimento
res-accel-chip.desc: Nome della sezione accelerometro usata dal resonance tester (es. adxl345).

res-probe-points.title: Coordinate Test di Risonanza
res-probe-points.desc: Coordinate X, Y, Z dove posizionare la testina durante la vibrazione di test.

res-accel-per-hz.title: Accelerazione per Hertz
res-accel-per-hz.desc: Fattore di accelerazione applicato per ciascun Hz durante lo sweep delle frequenze.

res-max-smoothing.title: Livellamento Massimo Tollerato
res-max-smoothing.desc: Massimo fattore di smoothing accettabile durante il calcolo automatico dello shaper ottimale.

input-moonraker-url.title: Indirizzo Istanza Moonraker
input-moonraker-url.desc: Indirizzo IP o hostname con porta del server Moonraker che controlla Klipper (es. http://192.168.1.50:7125). Lasciare vuoto per autorilevamento sulla stessa macchina.
input-moonraker-url.tip: Default: origine corrente (stesso host di Mainsail)

check-force-light-mode.title: Forza Modalità Chiara
check-force-light-mode.desc: Forza l'interfaccia grafica in tema chiaro invece di sincronizzare il tema scuro da Mainsail.
check-force-light-mode.tip: Consigliato non attivo per abbinamento perfetto a Mainsail

check-virtual-sd.title: Abilitazione Virtual SD Card
check-virtual-sd.desc: Permette a Klipper di eseguire direttamente i file G-Code caricati su Moonraker o Mainsail nel disco locale.
check-virtual-sd.tip: Indispensabile per il funzionamento di Mainsail e Moonraker

check-pause-resume.title: Abilitazione Pausa e Ripresa
check-pause-resume.desc: Abilita il supporto ai comandi PAUSE e RESUME nativi di Klipper, necessari per cambi filamento e pause di emergenza.

check-display-status.title: Stato di Avanzamento Stampa
check-display-status.desc: Fornisce lo stato di avanzamento percentuale e messaggi di stato alla web interface e agli schermi.

check-respond.title: Comando Risposta Console (M118)
check-respond.desc: Permette ai comandi M118 e RESPOND di scrivere messaggi informativi nella console interattiva di Mainsail.
check-respond.tip: Utile per script e macro avanzate

idle-timeout.title: Tempo di Timeout Inattività
idle-timeout.desc: Secondi di inattività trascorsi i quali Klipper disattiva automaticamente motori e riscaldatori per sicurezza energetica e termica.

adxl-spi-mode.desc: Select whether the ADXL345 accelerometer communicates via a dedicated Hardware SPI bus or via Software SPI pins (Bitbanging).
adxl-spi-mode.hardware: Use Hardware SPI if wired to native MCU or toolhead SPI pins; use Software SPI to freely assign SCLK, MOSI, and MISO pins.

adxl-spi-sclk.desc: Clock pin (SCK/SCLK) used for Software SPI communication with the ADXL345 accelerometer.
adxl-spi-sclk.hardware: Required only in Software SPI mode (e.g., PB13, gpio10, EBBCan:PB10).

adxl-spi-mosi.desc: Master Out Slave In (MOSI / SDA) pin used to send Software SPI data to the ADXL345 accelerometer.
adxl-spi-mosi.hardware: Required only in Software SPI mode (e.g., PB15, gpio11, EBBCan:PB11).

adxl-spi-miso.desc: Master In Slave Out (MISO / SDO) pin used to receive Software SPI data from the ADXL345 accelerometer.
adxl-spi-miso.hardware: Required only in Software SPI mode (e.g., PB14, gpio12, EBBCan:PB2).

check-enable-resonance-tester.title: Enable Resonance Tester Section
check-enable-resonance-tester.desc: Enables the [resonance_tester] section to run automated resonance tests (SHAPER_CALIBRATE and TEST_RESONANCES) using the accelerometer.
check-enable-resonance-tester.tip: Requires a configured accelerometer such as [adxl345]

calibration-z-offset.title: Probe Z-Offset Height
calibration-z-offset.desc: Vertical distance between the Z probe trigger point and the nozzle tip (synchronized with the Probe card).
calibration-z-offset.tip: A higher value moves the nozzle closer to the bed

extruder-sensor-spi-mode.title: Sensor SPI Connection Mode
extruder-sensor-spi-mode.desc: Select whether the thermal amplifier (MAX31865/MAX6675) communicates via hardware SPI bus or software SPI pins.
extruder-sensor-spi-mode.tip: Use Hardware SPI when connected to native SPI pins

extruder-sensor-spi-bus.title: Thermal Sensor SPI Bus
extruder-sensor-spi-bus.desc: Hardware SPI bus identifier on the MCU connected to the temperature sensor (e.g., spi1, spi2).

extruder-sensor-spi-sclk.title: Sensor Software SPI SCLK Pin
extruder-sensor-spi-sclk.desc: Serial clock pin (SCK/SCLK) for software SPI communication with the thermal sensor.

extruder-sensor-spi-mosi.title: Sensor Software SPI MOSI Pin
extruder-sensor-spi-mosi.desc: Master Out Slave In (MOSI/SDI) data pin for software SPI communication with the thermal sensor.

extruder-sensor-spi-miso.title: Sensor Software SPI MISO Pin
extruder-sensor-spi-miso.desc: Master In Slave Out (MISO/SDO) data pin for software SPI communication with the thermal sensor.

extruder-sensor-rtd-nominal.desc: Nominal resistance at 0°C of the RTD sensor connected to the MAX31865 amplifier.
extruder-sensor-rtd-nominal.hardware: Set 100 for PT100 sensors or 1000 for PT1000 sensors.

extruder-sensor-rtd-reference.desc: Reference resistor value soldered onto the MAX31865 amplifier board.
extruder-sensor-rtd-reference.hardware: Typically 430 Ω for PT100 modules and 4300 Ω for PT1000 modules (check the resistor marking on your board).

extruder-sensor-rtd-wires.desc: Number of wires on the PT100/PT1000 sensor connected to the MAX31865 chip (2, 3, or 4 wires).
extruder-sensor-rtd-wires.hardware: Also verify the jumper/DIP switch settings on your board for 2/3/4-wire configuration.

extruder-driver-type.desc: Stepper driver model dedicated to the extruder motor.
extruder-driver-type.hardware: Select TMC2209/TMC2208 for UART drivers or TMC5160/TMC2130 for SPI drivers; choose 'None' for standalone mode.

extruder-driver-pin.desc: Digital communication pin (UART or SPI Chip Select) connected to the extruder driver.
extruder-driver-pin.hardware: Allows Klipper to configure motor current, microstepping, and StealthChop/SpreadCycle in software.

extruder-driver-diag-pin.desc: StallGuard diagnostic pin for the extruder driver (optional).
extruder-driver-diag-pin.hardware: Rarely used on the extruder; leave blank unless needed for specific filament detection setups.

extruder-driver-spi-mode.title: Extruder Driver SPI Mode
extruder-driver-spi-mode.desc: Select between MCU hardware SPI bus or software SPI pins for the extruder driver.

extruder-driver-spi-bus.title: Extruder Driver Hardware SPI Bus
extruder-driver-spi-bus.desc: Hardware SPI bus identifier on the MCU connected to the extruder driver (e.g., spi1, spi2).

extruder-driver-spi-sclk.title: Extruder Driver Software SPI SCLK Pin
extruder-driver-spi-sclk.desc: Serial clock pin (SCK/SCLK) for the extruder driver's software SPI bus.

extruder-driver-spi-mosi.title: Extruder Driver Software SPI MOSI Pin
extruder-driver-spi-mosi.desc: Master Out Slave In (MOSI/SDI) data pin for the extruder driver's software SPI bus.

extruder-driver-spi-miso.title: Extruder Driver Software SPI MISO Pin
extruder-driver-spi-miso.desc: Master In Slave Out (MISO/SDO) data pin for the extruder driver's software SPI bus.

extruder-driver-current.desc: RMS electrical current (in Amps) delivered to the extruder motor during printing.
extruder-driver-current.hardware: For NEMA14 pancake motors (Orbiter, Sherpa Mini, SB) use 0.35A - 0.65A; for standard NEMA17 use 0.60A - 0.85A.

extruder-driver-stealthchop.title: Extruder StealthChop / SpreadCycle Mode
extruder-driver-stealthchop.desc: Speed threshold for quiet mode. SpreadCycle (0) is recommended on extruders to maximize torque and accuracy.

virtual-sd-path.title: G-Code Files Directory Path
virtual-sd-path.desc: Linux filesystem path where Moonraker and Klipper store and read G-Code print files.

extruder-sensor-spi-speed.title: Sensor SPI Clock Speed
extruder-sensor-spi-speed.desc: SPI bus communication speed in Hertz for the thermal amplifier.

extruder-driver-model-select.title: Extruder Driver Model
extruder-driver-model-select.desc: Stepper driver model installed for the extruder motor (e.g., TMC2209, TMC5160, Standalone).

extruder-driver-conn-type-select.title: Extruder Driver Communication Type
extruder-driver-conn-type-select.desc: Data communication mode between the MCU/toolhead and the extruder driver (UART, SPI, or Standalone).

extruder-driver-uart-pin.title: Extruder Driver UART Pin
extruder-driver-uart-pin.desc: Bidirectional digital pin used for serial UART communication with the extruder driver.

extruder-driver-tx-pin.title: Extruder Driver Dedicated TX Pin
extruder-driver-tx-pin.desc: Separate transmit pin used only on boards that do not use a single-wire UART line.

extruder-driver-uart-address.title: UART Multi-Node Address
extruder-driver-uart-address.desc: Hardware address (0-3) of the driver when multiple TMC2209 chips share the same UART line.

extruder-driver-cs-pin.title: Extruder Driver SPI Chip Select Pin
extruder-driver-cs-pin.desc: Chip Select (CS) enable pin for the extruder driver on an SPI bus.

extruder-driver-run-current.title: Extruder Run Current
extruder-driver-run-current.desc: RMS current delivered to the extruder motor during printing (typically 0.35A - 0.70A for NEMA14 pancake motors).
extruder-driver-run-current.tip: Do not exceed pancake motor rated current to avoid softening PLA filament

extruder-check-enable-hold-current.title: Enable Extruder Hold Current
extruder-check-enable-hold-current.desc: Enables reduced current when the extruder is idle. Klipper discourages hold_current on extruders to avoid oozing or retraction inaccuracies.

extruder-driver-hold-current.title: Extruder Hold Current
extruder-driver-hold-current.desc: Current maintained in the motor windings when the extruder motor is at standstill.

extruder-check-enable-sense-resistor.title: Specify Extruder Sense Resistor
extruder-check-enable-sense-resistor.desc: Enables manual entry of the current sense resistor value for the extruder driver.

extruder-driver-sense-resistor.title: Extruder Driver Sense Resistor
extruder-driver-sense-resistor.desc: Resistance in Ohms of the current sense resistors on the driver board.

extruder-driver-interpolate.title: 256 Microstep Interpolation
extruder-driver-interpolate.desc: Enables internal 256 microstep driver interpolation for the extruder (interpolate: True).

calc-drive-type.title: Mechanical Drive Type
calc-drive-type.desc: Select between toothed belt drive (GT2 2mm) or leadscrew to calculate rotation_distance.

calc-pulley-teeth.title: Pulley Teeth Count
calc-pulley-teeth.desc: Number of teeth on the drive pulley mounted on the motor shaft (e.g., 16 or 20 teeth).

calc-leadscrew-pitch.title: Leadscrew Lead
calc-leadscrew-pitch.desc: Millimeters of linear travel per full screw revolution (e.g., T8x8 = 8, T8x4 = 4, T8x2 = 2).

mcu-name-input.title: Secondary MCU Identifier Name
mcu-name-input.desc: Unique name of the secondary board or toolhead MCU used in pin prefixes (e.g., toolhead:PA0, rpi:gpio12).

mcu-conn-type-select.title: MCU Connection Method
mcu-conn-type-select.desc: Select between CAN Bus (canbus_uuid), USB serial port (/dev/serial/by-id/...), or Linux host MCU process (/tmp/klipper_host_mcu).

mcu-address-input.title: MCU Address or CAN UUID
mcu-address-input.desc: Linux USB serial device path or 12-character hexadecimal UUID for CAN Bus boards.

mcu-restart-input.title: MCU Restart Method
mcu-restart-input.desc: Method used by the host to reset the microcontroller (e.g., command, arduino, rpi_usb).

fan-type-select.title: Klipper Fan Type
fan-type-select.desc: Defines fan behavior: heater_fan (hotend heatsink), controller_fan (electronics/drivers), temperature_fan (thermally regulated), or fan_generic (manual control).

fan-name-input.title: Auxiliary Fan Name
fan-name-input.desc: Unique identifier of the fan in Klipper and Mainsail (e.g., hotend_fan, controller_fan, chamber_fan).

fan-pin-input.title: Fan Control Pin
fan-pin-input.desc: MOSFET output pin on the motherboard or toolhead powering the fan.

fan-heater-input.title: Associated Heater
fan-heater-input.desc: Heater monitored to automatically trigger the fan (default: extruder).

fan-heater-temp-input.title: Activation Temperature
fan-heater-temp-input.desc: Temperature threshold above which the fan turns on automatically (default: 50.0 °C).

fan-stepper-input.title: Monitored Stepper Motors
fan-stepper-input.desc: List of steppers that activate the controller fan when energized (leave empty for all steppers).

fan-sens-type-input.title: Temperature Sensor Type
fan-sens-type-input.desc: Thermistor model used to measure temperature for the temperature-controlled fan.

fan-sens-pin-input.title: Temperature Sensor Pin
fan-sens-pin-input.desc: Analog input pin connected to the fan's thermistor.

fan-target-temp-input.title: Target Temperature
fan-target-temp-input.desc: Target temperature maintained by the temperature-controlled fan.

fan-max-power-input.title: Maximum Fan Power
fan-max-power-input.desc: Maximum PWM power output delivered to the fan (from 0.0 to 1.0, default: 1.0).

led-type-select.title: LED Lighting Type
led-type-select.desc: neopixel: addressable WS2812/SK6812 strips; led: standard Klipper [led] module for RGB/RGBW/White pins; output_pin: monochrome PWM LED bar.

led-name-input.title: LED Identifier Name
led-name-input.desc: Name of the LED section in Klipper and Mainsail (e.g., caselight, sb_leds).

led-pin-input.title: Main or White LED Pin
led-pin-input.desc: Data pin for Neopixel strips, output pin for output_pin, or white_pin for [led] sections.

led-chain-input.title: LED Chain Count
led-chain-input.desc: Total number of addressable LED diodes connected in series on the Neopixel strip.

led-order-select.title: Color Channel Order
led-order-select.desc: Hardware color sequence of the Neopixel chips (GRB for WS2812B, GRBW or RGBW for SK6812).

led-red-input.title: Red Channel Pin
led-red-input.desc: Microcontroller pin connected to the Red channel of the standard [led] strip.

led-green-input.title: Green Channel Pin
led-green-input.desc: Microcontroller pin connected to the Green channel of the standard [led] strip.

led-blue-input.title: Blue Channel Pin
led-blue-input.desc: Microcontroller pin connected to the Blue channel of the standard [led] strip.

led-cycle-input.title: PWM Cycle Time
led-cycle-input.desc: Duration in seconds of the PWM cycle for LED brightness control (Klipper default: 0.010).

macro-desc-input.title: Macro Description
macro-desc-input.desc: Short descriptive text displayed as a tooltip on the macro button in Mainsail and Fluidd.

macro-gcode-input.title: G-Code / Jinja2 Body
macro-gcode-input.desc: Sequence of G-Code commands and Jinja2 template expressions executed when the macro is called.
